independence.author: separate implementation agent
independence.basis: User scope/common requirement 0.3 and public HTTP/input contracts; no current planning test case bodies or development counterexample details read to construct these samples.
independence.limits: Agent-authored deterministic rules are not independent human truth or general semantic accuracy; novelty is relative to this author knowledge, not a corpus-wide duplicate proof.

freeze_policy: Never replace a case or lower a rule after its first HTTP result. Preserve success and failure.
A failed held-out case becomes development evidence; subsequent fixes/rechecks must be a separate report and cannot reuse its holdout designation.
Do not retry an entire sample for a better result. Task polling is allowed within the fixed deadline.
Keep inputs/rules/source hashes immutable. Any implementation-version drift must be recorded and rejected by this runner before account creation.

execution_boundary.only: Real Java HTTP + PostgreSQL + Agent inside explicit isolated fixture stack; fixture provider responses replace paid suppliers only.
prohibited: Claiming a human or live-model assessment
execution_boundary.network: Only loopback HTTP/HTTPS base URLs; redirects refused.
execution_boundary.provider_truth: Synthetic map facts, synthetic fixture LLM, and runtime provider observed/expiry stamps; source code hashes freeze the fixture definition. Response artifacts retain returned facts/stamps. No snapshot of a live supplier cache is claimed.

common_rules.rule: Every accepted plan has exactly day 0 Beijing and day 1 Shanghai; no silent day loss or cross-city attraction reassignment.
Task must end succeeded/needs_attention with a persisted trip. Explicit HTTP failure or missing expected prerequisites is a retained failed sample, not skipped.
A feasible day must have no stale flag, unknowns or conflicts. An unverified/infeasible day must carry an explicit nonempty explanation in feasibility or quality.
Unknowns and omitted activity IDs must be retained in artifacts. No structural score is described as actual route truth, semantic truth or model accuracy.

cases.title: 跨城固定铁路与用户预约声明交叉

request.free_text_input: 冻结留出A：第1日北京，第2日先乘已确认08:10—13:25固定铁路至上海；到站提前量45分钟是用户声明，不能当作官方事实。

steps: Generate a persisted two-day plan through the durable Agent task.
Retrieve authoritative planning input. Bind the first returned day-1 attraction POI, requiring a nonempty real activity/POI ID.
Add exactly one user-declared not_required reservation fact for that POI/date through planning-input PUT, preserving all other input.
Read back persisted input and current validity. No solve/reverify retry is used to turn this case green.

rules.rule: The persisted fixed railway keeps ID, fixed interval, origin/destination city/name/coordinates and confirmed category/status; compare instants, not timezone spelling.
The buffer remains 45 minutes, with exact supplied source, authority, confirmed flag and timestamps; it must not acquire official authority.
The new reservation fact is persisted for exactly the bound Shanghai POI/date with exact user source/authority/status/timestamps.
Adding the Shanghai-specific fact invalidates day 1; day 0 city, activities, timeline, feasibility and stale status are unchanged.

If the initial Shanghai day claims feasible, its timeline contains the fixed railway interval and no tourism attraction overlaps it. Otherwise explicit unknown/infeasible with reasons is allowed while the fixed input is still conserved.

cases.title: 局部住宿依赖变化与异日内容保护交叉

request.free_text_input: 冻结留出B：第1日北京、第2日上海；随后只修改上海住宿端点，未受影响的北京日和内容保护应保留。

steps: Generate a separate persisted two-day plan through the Agent task.
Content-lock the first returned day-0 attraction by its real activity ID. Capture the authoritative state after the accepted lock.
Change only the day-1 hotel name/location through planning-input PUT; preserve its other inputs and the content lock.

Try time-lock then completed=true for the first day-1 attraction using the latest version/revision. Both must reject as SCHEDULE_STALE, and every rejected request must leave authoritative input/revisions/plan unchanged.

rules.rule: The content lock is actually persisted before the hotel edit and survives afterward; its attraction content is unchanged.
Only day-1 hotel input changes; day 1 becomes schedule_stale=true; day 0 city, attractions, meals, hotel, timeline, feasibility and stale flag equal the post-lock baseline.
Time-lock and completion each return HTTP 409 with code SCHEDULE_STALE using latest revision/version. Generic denial does not pass.
Each rejected state write leaves planning_revision, trip_version, complete planning_input and plan equal to its pre-request authoritative snapshot.

scoring.pass: All common and per-case binary rules pass; prerequisites count as rules and cannot skip.
scoring.aggregation: Report each case, each rule and total passed/total; do not pool this into a real-model accuracy percentage.
scoring.comparison_baseline: Within-case immutable pre-edit authoritative HTTP snapshot, not an invented old-version implementation.
scoring.human_review: Package retained JSON/response artifacts for later independent review; no reviewer or approval fabricated.
